The Samsung Gear Sport is a smartwatch developed by Samsung Electronics. The Gear Sport was released at Samsung Galaxy Unpacked in 2017.[1]

Specifications

Model Samsung Gear Sport Ref.
Display 1.2” 360 x 360 Super AMOLED Full color AOD, Gorilla Glass3 [2][3]
Operating System Tizen 3.0 (updateable to 4.0.0.7 - One UI as of May 2019)
Weight 67g
RAM 768MB
Storage 4GB
Water Resistant 5ATM
Connectivity Bluetooth 4.2, Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n), GPS/Glonass, NFC
Sensors Accelerometer, Gyro Sensor, Barometer, Heart Rate Monitor, Ambient Light
Battery 300mAh
